same_version_temporal_fragments.implementation: Reuse original DepthState and predict exactly; no all-temporal-fragment pooling or new history database in approved DS6. Make a separate state_measurement per arm whose core/core_usable are explicit interface aliases for single-qualified-piece summary/eligibility.
same_version_temporal_fragments.version: existing (segment,arm,generation,public,epoch), plus native implicit in live[native]; verify current public/epoch/generation. Each segment starts empty.
same_version_temporal_fragments.scalar_policy: Only exactly one qualified spatial piece can contribute median/MAD to scalar history; >=2 or0 qualified means unusable history observation, cuts active fitted fragment under original update. Preserve anonymous spatial facts even when unusable.
same_version_temporal_fragments.classes: existing SOURCE_OBSERVATION/RESTORED_POST only; group/POST_UNASSIGNED/risk/invalid/skip/non-increasing time cut history; previous completed fragment may remain within original30-frame freeze window.
same_version_temporal_fragments.freeze_order: before first-suspect measurement; immutable snapshot cutoff<=suspect_frame-1; q admitted only once after accepted restore as new active fragment
same_version_temporal_fragments.history_sharing: D4/D5 share raw selection facts and history eligibility policy. They must have separate live DepthState objects keyed to their own committed public/epoch/generation after decisions diverge; common frozen-state shadow may be a diagnostic only.
same_version_temporal_fragments.temporal_vs_spatial: MULTIFRAGMENT denotes anonymous spatial pieces at q, not a mixture of multiple temporal fitted fragments.

minimum_multifragment_score.signature: multifragment_choice(episode, original_latest_frozen, current_F6_scalar_and_qualified_pieces, original_full, depth_weight=.25) -> choice, all4 edge detail
minimum_multifragment_score.approved_history: one original latest continuous fragment per A/B role, forecast by original predict; D4/D5 use same eligibility policy, no linking/stacking histories across risk
minimum_multifragment_score.piece_weights: for source with K qualified pieces: each weight1/K; qualification itself depends only current raw descriptors, no roles/candidates/history/GT. All unqualified pieces remain logged and explicitly excluded from q likelihood.
minimum_multifragment_score.formula: D5 role/source ratio R=(1/K)*sum_j exp(log_t4(z_j, mu_role, hypot(prediction_scale_role,max(15,1.4826*MAD_j)))-log_t4(z_j,shared_background_mu,shared_background_scale)); cost=-log(0.9*R+0.1), in log space. D4 uses original F6 selected scalar median/MAD in same Student-t expression.
minimum_multifragment_score.joint_availability: a single role/source availability gate shared by D4/D5 includes valid shared raw background; valid forecast for both A/B roles; valid full F6 selected scalar for both post sources; at least one qualified current piece for both post sources. If any of4 edges fails, all4 depth costs0.
minimum_multifragment_score.geometry: same original position+0.25 motion term, same pairings, depth coefficient0.25, total tie<=1e-9 temporary_choice
minimum_multifragment_score.background: original raw full-frame median and max(60,1.4826*full MAD) unchanged; no clean-plane full-background intervention
minimum_multifragment_score.singleton_oracle: If selected contains exactly one piece with all selected points, D4 and D5 edge likelihoods/scores/choice exactly coincide. If one qualified piece plus unqualified residues, they may differ intentionally: D4 scalar includes residues, D5 excludes them.
minimum_multifragment_score.no_identity_claim: equal mixture is a measurement likelihood; neither largest, nearest, lowest-depth nor highest-weight piece is certified fish
minimum_multifragment_score.implementation_minimum: reuse original log_t4/predict/geometry; one local DS6 score helper and explicit joint gate, avoid patching old module globals

isolated_and_unisolated_factors.physical_boundary: track identity metrics can measure actual publication changes; no physical camera-Z/surface/underwater calibration accuracy is measured.

approval_notes: No new temporal multi-fragment pool, no hard closest/largest selector and no independent qualification platform.

If “share prestate” was intended as one literal live state for D4/D5 after their publications diverge, that violates same-version own-branch contract; use identical prestate policy in separate objects.
Shared joint gate must include qualified current post-piece availability for D4 as well as D5; otherwise their missing-evidence policies differ.
History scalar and q scalar are distinct objects; do not mutate shared measured dict or controller profiles.
No added performance thresholds or scientific effect claim in this review; root seals actual implementation then runs full1471.
